messages:
ingrid (auditor): Hey folks, auditor request: we need an evidence bundle for the new inference-routing service. Deliverables: RBAC change history, confirmation that service owners have MFA enforced, KMS key usage logs for the service principal (last 30 days), brief vuln triage summary, and the documented emergency key access procedure. Deadline: Tue 09:00 PST. Please mark anything sensitive.
meera (sec-eng): On it. Clarify: do you want prod only or prod+staging? Also do you need raw CloudTrail or a CSV extract?
sam (infra): Prod + staging. I'll prepare a CSV extract (first/last events and any anomalies flagged). KMS CMK alias is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing.
liz (devops): RBAC change was introduced in PR 4892 (service-role: rw-inference-run). Approved by @meera and @andre on 2024-11-06. I can include the PR diff and the approver comments. Role scoped to kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, s3:GetObject for model-bucket/*, ecs:StartTask.
meera (sec-eng): MFA: owners are in IdP group "sec-service-owners". Conditional access policy CA-PrivOps-MFA has been enforced org-wide since 2024-08-15. I'll attach the policy ID and a screenshot with the policy timestamp.
jordan (oncall): For KMS logs, here's the Splunk query I used to extract decrypt/generate events for that key: 
```
index=prod_kms source=cloudtrail arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing (Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey)
| table _time,user,src_ip,eventName,requestParameters
| head 500
```
jordan (oncall): I can export CSV and redact IPs for the public bundle; full logs via secure transfer.
ingrid (auditor): Need an example of a normal decrypt event and a key rotation/RotateKey event in the bundle. Also proof that the service principal has no admin privileges.
sam (infra): Normal decrypt (CloudTrail shortened):
```
2024-11-11T09:14:03Z Decrypt arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/rw-inference-run/service-account requestParameters: {keyId: alias/rw-infer-routing}
```
sam (infra): RotateKey shows RotateKey / ScheduleKeyDeletion / CreateKey events; rotation manifests stored at s3://redwood-audit/kms-rotations/ with index file.
liz (devops): IAM diff in PR 4892 shows no iam:*, no kms:CreateKey, and explicit deny for iam:PassRole to production admins. I'll include the PR diff and a short statement about least privilege.
meera (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage (last 30 days): 1 medium finding — outdated base image (CVE-2024-xxxx). Ticket SEC-2024-214 assigned to @liz; fix merged and deployed 2024-11-19. No open high/critical findings for this service. I'll write a 2-line triage summary.
meera (sec-eng): Emergency access runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-emergency-access — it lists escalation, MFA verification steps, and audit tagging requirements. I'll add a note pointing to the inference service in the runbook.
ingrid (auditor): Also confirm retention policy for KMS logs and where the golden copy is kept. And please indicate which files are sensitive in the bundle.
sam (infra): Golden copy retention: s3://redwood-audit/golden/kms/ (governed bucket) with 7-year retention and immutability. Export we provide will be a 30-day slice.
meera (sec-eng): We'll mark KMS logs and any full ARNs/IPs as restricted. Public bundle will have redacted IPs and truncated ARNs. Full set sent via SFTP: sftp://auditor-upload.redwood/1758246789-infer-routing-evidence (credentials shared out-of-band).
jordan (oncall): FYI security-bot showed a KMS canary alert on 2024-11-20 03:12 UTC; investigated and root cause was the infra canary key test. I'll include the incident note and the canary runbook entry.
ingrid (auditor): Great. Please upload bundle by Mon 07:00 PST so we can map to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2.2. Thank you.
meera (sec-eng): Will upload and post confirmation here when complete.
security-bot: Incident bot: no active incidents for inference-routing-service in the last 90 days.
